title.zh: 冒烟：等窗口出现，而不是睡固定时长
title.en: Smoke: wait for the window instead of sleeping a fixed time

intent.zh: 聚焦改动让区域拾取覆盖层就绪稍晚（最多多约 0.4 秒：先接线程输入队列再 SetForegroundWindow），而区域模块用 1500ms 固定睡眠等它 —— 于是"拖动返回客户区矩形"和"单击选中整个客户区"两条断言开始挂（拾取器还在跑，exited=False）。修法不是把 1500 改大，而是 `common.ps1` 提供 `Wait-ForWindow`：轮询窗口列表直到覆盖层出现，再留 250ms 让它装好鼠标捕获。三处固定睡眠都换掉了，区域模块 27 项、全量 129 项全过。
intent.en: The focus change made the region-picker overlay ready slightly later (up to about 0.4s: attach the thread input queue, then SetForegroundWindow), while the region module waited a fixed 1500ms - so the dragged-rectangle and click-selects-all checks started failing with the picker still running. The fix is not a bigger sleep: common.ps1 now offers Wait-ForWindow, which polls the window list until the overlay exists and then gives it 250ms to arm. All three fixed sleeps are gone; the region module is back to 27 checks and the full suite to 129.

acceptance: 区域拾取的两条交互断言重新通过（拖动 / 单击）
冒烟里不再有"等覆盖层"的固定睡眠；三处都换成等窗口出现
全量冒烟 129 项 0 失败
note: 冒烟不再睡固定时长：等覆盖层出现再动手。
